supporting_observations.claim: From 13:36 through 13:51 UTC, svc-inventory failures recur at roughly one-minute intervals. The records identify FILE-BLU-01 as the workstation and 10.54.20.20 as the source address; the failures report an incorrect-password status.

Domain-controller records also show repeated svc-inventory pre-authentication or credential-validation failures associated with FILE-BLU-01, including status 0x18 in 4771 events and 0xc000006a in 4776 events.

The recurring failures begin after the scheduled 13:30 UTC svc-inventory password rotation and are consistent with the stated once-per-minute InventorySync re-authentication and a job that has not yet been updated with the rotated password. This is a plausible benign explanation, not proof of the cause.

Before and shortly after the scheduled rotation, SYSTEM running PowerShell on WS-EBROOKS-01 and WS-MSANTOS-01 attempted explicit use of svc-inventory credentials, targeting DC-BLU-01 and FILE-BLU-01 respectively. These attempts are not explained by the stated InventorySync job location or the stated IT patching practice, and warrant investigation; these records alone do not establish that authentication succeeded.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records end at 13:51:16 UTC, so they do not cover the full requested window through 14:20 UTC.
The supplied evidence is authentication-focused and does not include process execution details, task/job logs, or audit records for the password rotation and manual job update.
The records do not map source address 10.54.20.20 to an inventoried host or establish who initiated the workstation PowerShell activity.
claims_not_established: Whether either explicit-credential attempt from WS-EBROOKS-01 or WS-MSANTOS-01 succeeded.
Who initiated those PowerShell activity attempts, why they occurred, or whether they were authorized.
Whether the repeated failures were solely caused by the InventorySync job retaining the old password.
Whether the InventorySync job was updated, and what authentication activity occurred after 13:51 UTC.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect DC-BLU-01 and FILE-BLU-01 successful and failed authentication records for svc-inventory through 14:20 UTC, including any corresponding logon sessions.
Collect process-creation, PowerShell, and interactive-session telemetry from WS-EBROOKS-01 and WS-MSANTOS-01 around the 4648 events; identify the initiating user, command line, and outcome.
Review FILE-BLU-01 InventorySync task/job logs and configuration history, plus audit evidence of the scheduled password rotation and manual update.
Use DHCP, IPAM, or network records to identify the owner of 10.54.20.20 and corroborate the source of the recurring failures.
